description: Static React SPA using Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, and Recharts. Builds to static files served by nginx.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a portfolio site, a dashboard, a business app - all client-side
ui.description: Vite + React + Tailwind. Builds to static HTML/CSS/JS served by nginx. No server-side rendering.

sample_prompts: A project management dashboard with kanban board and team overview
An invoicing app for a plumbing business with customer tracking
A personal finance tracker with charts and expense categories
